scope: Same-binary native lifecycle through custody, durable open, bounded upload body, finite pre-network request failure and close; no libcoap exchange acceptance

source_identity.kind: exact source-file SHA-256; no source commit association asserted

assertions: Public --custody ABS_DIRECTORY dispatch execs the same absolute binary with only --worker
Pinned ready identity and correlated JSON responses survive printable quote/backslash request identities
Canonical credential bytes are decoded into bounded storage, erased after identity derivation and never placed in argv
Successful open durably consumes boundary 32 and holds the exclusive store lock until close
A concurrent process receives context_store_locked and orderly reopen receives fresh_context_required
Begin/chunk/end admits one exact SHA-256-verified body; unsupported request returns native_unavailable before network I/O
Nonblocking output is bounded to 512 KiB and retains an original deadline for each queued frame
Malformed framing terminates without creating store state
unaccepted: libcoap context/session ownership and request, Observe, cancellation or report-credit dispatch
Protected exchange, response Message encoding, blockwise result streaming and live replay
Port mailbox/output saturation, production cleanup stress and complete native-v1 corpus
Reproducible native Mix build/run orchestration and final software matrix
